name: CodeCraft
description: CodeCraft is the premier competitive programming and software engineering society at the college. We host algorithmic problem-solving bootcamps, code sprints, and internal hackathons, with alumni placing in top tech firms and representing the institute at ACM-ICPC.
shortDescription: Premier programming & competitive coding club. Weekly algorithmic contests & mentorship.

name: InnovatAI
description: InnovatAI is dedicated to exploring Artificial Intelligence, Neural Networks, Large Language Models, and Machine Learning applications. Members work on open-source datasets, publish research pre-prints, and build autonomous agents.
shortDescription: Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning and Applied Machine Learning research group.

name: RoboPulse
description: The collegiate robotics and embedded systems club. We design, solder, and program autonomous rovers, combat bots, and IoT hardware solutions. Winners of the National Robotics Championship 2023.
shortDescription: Robotics, microcontrollers, IoT automation, and combat bot engineering.

name: CyberShield
description: CyberShield is the ethical hacking and network security guild. Members train in penetration testing, reverse engineering, web exploitation, and regularly place in international Capture-The-Flag (CTF) challenges.
shortDescription: Cybersecurity, CTF competitions, cryptography & penetration testing.

name: PixelCraft Studio
description: A collective of digital product designers, UI/UX researchers, 3D modelers, and brand strategists. We craft intuitive digital experiences, run design sprints, and collaborate with student startups.
shortDescription: Product design, UI/UX architecture, 3D modeling, and visual communication.

name: VentureSphere (E-Cell)
description: The student entrepreneurship cell fostering innovative student ventures. We conduct pitch competitions, angel investor sessions, and provide pre-seed incubation support to student founders on campus.
shortDescription: Campus Entrepreneurship Cell, startup incubation & investor demo days.

name: Rhythm & Rhapsody
description: The official collegiate music and stage arts ensemble. From classical symphony and acoustic bands to contemporary dance, we curate the annual campus festival and live acoustic night sessions.
shortDescription: Official music, dance, acoustics and performing arts society.

name: SportSync
description: SportSync manages athletic and intramural sporting tournaments across football, basketball, cricket, badminton, and chess. Dedicated to physical conditioning and collegiate championship representation.
shortDescription: Inter-college athletics, tournaments, and intramural league management.

name: Aperture Guild
description: Photography, visual cinematography, and film production club. Capturing campus life, documenting technical hackathons, and producing short films and photo-journalism exhibitions.
shortDescription: Cinematography, documentary filmmaking, and digital photography guild.

name: Eloquence Literary Society
description: The premier debating, Model United Nations, and literary forum of the college. Training students in public speaking, parliamentary debate, creative writing, and policy analysis.
shortDescription: Debating society, Model UN delegations, public speaking and literary arts.

name: FinPulse
description: Quantitative finance, algorithmic trading, and algorithmic economy club. We host mock stock exchanges, financial modeling hackathons, and portfolio optimization workshops.
shortDescription: Quantitative finance, valuation modeling, and fintech analytics.

name: Green Campus Initiative
description: Dedicated to ecological sustainability, renewable campus micro-grids, and carbon-neutral student initiatives. Organizes energy audits, e-waste recycling, and environmental awareness forums.
shortDescription: Sustainability, eco-technology, and zero-carbon campus initiatives.
